name: Radar App
blurb: Radar App allows you to navigate through alternative and radical events in your location.
description:
Radar App allows you to navigate through alternative and radical events in your location.

Events are loaded from https://radar.squat.net

App allows getting the list of events with distance to their locations and adding them to your calendar, viewing location or sharing with friends.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
